ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure, the horizontal axis is time t (sec), and the vertical axis is velocity v. The velocity graph consists of three parts: the first straight line segment descends from about (0,3) to (3,0); then a quarter-circle arc descends from (3,0) to (5,-2), located below the t-axis; finally, a straight line segment rises from (5,-2) to (6,0). Reasoning: The question asks when speed increases. Speed is the absolute value of velocity, |v|, so on the velocity-time graph, when the velocity value is getting farther and farther from 0, speed increases. When 0<t<3, the velocity is positive and decreases from 3 to 0, getting closer and closer to 0, so speed decreases; when 3<t<5, the velocity decreases from 0 to -2, getting farther and farther from 0, so speed increases; when 5<t<6, the velocity rises from -2 to 0, getting closer and closer to 0, so speed decreases. Therefore the time interval during which speed increases is 3<t<5.

raw_record.question_text:
Use the graph below, consisting of two line segments and a quarter-circle. The graph shows the velocity of an object during a 6-second interval.

During what time interval (in sec) is the speed increasing?

method.method_draft: Read the plotted velocity graph by intervals: the first straight segment goes from about (0,3) down to (3,0), the curved quarter-circle goes from (3,0) down to (5,-2), and the final straight segment goes from (5,-2) up to (6,0). From the text, identify that the vertical coordinate is velocity and the question asks when speed is increasing. Use the rule that speed is |velocity|, so on a velocity-time graph speed increases when the velocity value moves farther from 0. The graph moves farther below the t-axis only on the quarter-circle from t=3 to t=5, so the interval is 3<t<5.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中横轴是时间 t（sec），纵轴是速度 v。速度图像由三部分组成：第一条直线段从约 (0,3) 下降到 (3,0)；接着一段四分之一圆弧从 (3,0) 下降到 (5,-2)，位于 t 轴下方；最后一条直线段从 (5,-2) 上升到 (6,0)。

推理：题目问 speed（速率）什么时候增加。速率是速度的绝对值 |v|，所以在速度-时间图上，当速度值离 0 越来越远时，速率增加。0<t<3 时速度为正且从 3 降到 0，离 0 越来越近，速率减少；3<t<5 时速度从 0 降到 -2，离 0 越来越远，速率增加；5<t<6 时速度从 -2 升到 0，离 0 越来越近，速率减少。因此速率增加的时间区间是 3<t<5。
method.answer_match_reason: The predicted answer exactly matches the standard answer: the speed is increasing on the interval 3 < t < 5.
